reviews.comment: Lectures are good, however, the video assignments are absurd. I truly cannot comprehend a reason they are so strict. Don't take this class unless you have time to go to recording hours. Or if you have a tripod, a COMPLETELY blank wall, and perfect lighting at home.

I absolutely love Ashley! She is fair and attendance is mandatory (taken beginning and end of class) so as long as you pay attention, you'll be okay. There's digital textbook with homework but you likely don't need too much time outside of required work to study unless you're having a hard time memorizing signs. Every class is engaging and helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: BEST CLASS EVER!!! This professor is so awesome and communicative, always quick to respond to emails. Attendance is a big part of your grade, missing one class can put you behind. Vocab quiz every class, but easy if you study. It is a lot of work, but so manageable and the professor is so nice. 10/10 would recommend you wont regret it!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Best ASL professor. There is only homework the week of the test: three assignments that prepare you. The exams are all memorization of signs and textbook facts. If you put in effort, you will get an A. When it's not an exam week there is never homework. My advice, participate, follow video guidelines, and USE HER STUDY MATERIALS! Ended with a 97!

I absolutely love Mrs. MacKay! She is so caring and an amazing professor. She made class so fun and I am taking her for ASL 2 next semester! If you get the opportunity to take a class with her, please do!

Professor Mackey is so sweet and dedicated to teaching… she taught us so much in such a short time and always has a positive attitude. We had quizzes pretty much every class at the beginning, but they were very easy as long as you pay attention during lectures. Her quizlets were super helpful as well. You will love her class!

While she was good at teaching the material, her grading was very inconsistent and she was very strict on video assignments. Video assignments had a certain criteria to follow, where if there was ANYTHING in the background or your camera was too low, you would receive a zero. I scored 80+ on every exam, but barely passed due to video assignments.

She is so sweet and adorable and you can tell she cares about each student, making the class feel more intimate. Providing feedback constantly and so helpful. This class is a voice off class so you aren't allowed to speak as she is deaf. Assignments are usually quizzes, exams and you have to record yourself signing. Attendance is important!

This class was great. Unlike other courses, she provides tons of practice quizzes and material that you can use to practice for the exams. The exams aren't hard and aren't made in a way to "trick" you. As long as you watch the videos and practice practice practice. You'll be so fine. 10/10.

This professor makes the class ten times harder than it needs to be. If they gave us an actual study guide and didn't try to make the tests as hard as possible I might actually get use out of the class. I'm not a finance major, and will probably never use any of the material ever again, so I don't know why I have to learn it in the first place.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her lectures are easy to understand and if you do the work youll definitely pass.

She is one of the best professors at explaining complex topics so it is easy to understand. Don't need the textbook, but you MUST watch the videos, they show everything step by step. Also love that it is mainly tests for our grade and not a bunch of "busy work"
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Challenging class, but if you put in the work you'll will be rewarded. 4 Exams count for most of your grade. Do not need to purchase textbook at all, just the note taking guide and financial calculator. Great communicator and very clear about what is due and when.

This was my second time taking FIN but first time with Whyte instead of Byrd. She is way better at explaining things and uses actual examples that help for exams. Her videos were extremely helpful. If you watch them, do the quizzes and practice exams this class is very doable. Use the TA's and help desk as often as possible.

I don't know why this professor doesn't have a lower grade. She's the reason I'm leaving UCF. She said all we need to know is in the note-taking guide. So i memorized the whole thing and guess what I got on the first exam? A C. And I'm a straight-A student. And I have a bachelor's degree. And now i can't get into my major. What'd I do wrong?
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The only class where textbooks and online codes aren't needed, thank God. Only regret I have is buying the note taking guide. Its just all the powerpoints in book form. You can just print it out for free. Financial Calc is strongly needed. Only complaint is that the exams are 20 questions, so each question is weighted heavily

This class is challenging, but not the most difficult in the world. The first test is easy and then it gets harder after that. If you want to get an A, you have to BUY the note taking guide. The quiz questions and review lectures do not correlate very well with the tests. You don't have to watch lectures, but it will help make the material easier.
Ended up with a 101% in the class. Teacher is straight forward and tests have everything she has covered in class. No trick questions.

Whyte really does all that she can to give you everything you need to pass. Don't listen to the people here saying its a hard class. It isn't, she even has extra credit on each exam. Oh and she isn't hot

Tests make up the majority of your grade. Didn't care for her. I knew the material very well and still failed almost every exam. One of those teachers that tries to trick you on exams instead of helping you learn. If you have time, it's manageable to get a B. Decently easy C.

I had a really tough time with this class. I watched all lectures, did practice problems, and STILL got 75s on all the tests. Feel like her test questions are confusing on purpose. I spent at least 8 hours a week and still didn't do well. Be wary...
Awesome teacher. Makes the content very easy to comprehend. Tests mostly consist of problems from study guide. Don't bother with the book just buy the study guide. Easy A if you try.
Great teacher, very smart, loves the subject. Class is easy if you watch all the lectures and labs, she is very thorough in her lectures.
Watch class but labs are where you learn the test material. If you do both consistently, easy A. Very fair in grading.

Great teacher who gave personalized 1 on 1 feedback on your rough draft before submitting the final drafts allowing you to fix any mistakes you made and secure an A. Only downside was that feedback would often be given day the final draft was due and most grades posted final week. May be because taken during Summer C though. Would recommend!

Grade is based on 4 writing projects, quizzes, and discussion posts. The work isn't hard, but prepare to spend plenty of time proofreading, doing doc design, and doing research. Highly recommend you do the extra credit works and reach out to Murphy when you need help. She will absolutely help you master tech writing if you reach out to her in time.

Started grading assignments the last week of the summer semester, very picky grader (go by rubric when doing assignments) 3 Projects & peer reviews and around 6 mini quizzes. She realized how serious I was about my grade from the many emails I sent and gave me ec opportunities. She's nice but the class was very disorganized which can hurt ur grade.

Breaks the class up into 3 sections: math, labs, and theory. The math and labs r easy as long as you keep up on your work and attend lectures. Theory is more textbook-based but I never read it and was able to do great because of the sheer amount of helpful resources she provides. Dont be afraid to utilize them bc sometimes things r reused in tests!
Such an amazing teacher! i loved her cat memes, shes the best ever

Prof Janowsky was very helpful whenever I had questions, her lectures were understandable and I liked her as a person. The class itself was organized, and you were overwhelmed by helpful resources in this class. I will say there was a lot of homework and 3 components to her tests, but as long as you do the math and lab homework you'll do fine.

TAs are super strict on grading.I am not usually good at math but I was able to understand everything she taught, and I was pretty confident during the tests.The textbook is mandatory, there will be a separate test just for the theory stuff.I would suggest looking at other professors,I have heard many students say there are other better professors
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I was really worried about this class but Dr. Janowsky made it so much better. The class itself can be challenging between the math, theory, and lab but she is awesome at teaching you exactly what you need to know. She is extremely organized and so nice and seems to really care about her students. She gives you all of the tools to succeed.
She lets you retake tests and stuff so thats cool but i swear to god she gave so much work. Not that the work is anything super hard or anything, it's just so much stuff it's overwhelming.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I truly enjoyed this class. I recommend taking it in person, so you can ask questions and see her work out the material. You have to read and study the information she goes over in class. She was very helpful and is always offering help before and after class. The math part was the easiest part for me. If you try your hardest, you'll pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Overall If you aren't interested in psych, this gep is boring and long. There is a lot of memorization, and you must know how to explain definitions and how they apply to specific circumstances. Dr. J is very kind/caring and explains things well, you just have to pay attention. Highly recommend attending lectures and taking notes

Exams are a bit confusing as far as information from the textbook goes.  You need to attend most lectures to do well because none of the information on the tests are easily studied for from the book.  Otherwise great professor, evenly distributed class work.

I love her. She made this class so fun and so worthwhile. She covers pretty much everything in the lectures, so you only have to look up certain things in the textbook. The exams are really easy if you pay attention to the lectures and review vocabulary.

Such a great professor and made lectures very entertaining! Got covid and was very accommodating as well. Attendance is not necessary but it's worth going with how well she explains everything and the games you play to help with lessons. Easy homework, just study well for exams. Open to questions and discussion, quick email responses.
Even if you don't want to go to the lectures, everything can be found in the textbook or in her notes that she provides for the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The instructor always provided power points, games, study guides, videos, and other helpful resources. Proctored quizzes with one page (front and back) of notes allowed. Easy discussions for homework, 7 quizzes and a departmental final. Always super organized, nice, and funny. 100% recommend.

Her lectures were the highlight of my day! She's super fun and makes jokes that you will remember for the exam. She gives a clear study guide straight from lecture & the textbook. She doesn't grade attendance, but she says things that will be on the exam. Your homework are discussions which can be toughly graded sometimes. Drops 1 bad exam too.

Mrs. Janowsky is a wonderful professor. Her classes are so much fun, and she is hilarious. She makes everything understandable and her tests are straight from the book and power points, which she posts online. You still should study, but I really liked her class.

Took this class online, pretty easy all around. There were 7 units, each with one 40 question quiz and one one-page paper. The paper was easy - a rubric was provided, and as long as you followed it you'd get a 100. The material was very interesting, and her unit outlines were fantastic!

Also took her for SocialPsy. Exams are difficult, but you WILL learn a lot. Expect to study well in advance for her exams. Tries very hard to make class interesting, very friendly. The textbooks will help you a LOT, esp. for Social, sometimes her lectures parallel chapters to a T. Got a B in both classes, completely possible to get an A with work!

This woman renewed my love for psychology. Attend every class, make sure you know all the material, including textbook reading. Super helpful, makes sure you really learn and understand. Plus, she's hilarious and sweet. Highly recommended.

She's amazing! Very upbeat and always willing to help. There's 3 quizzes and they're very tough, but study and get at least a C and you'll be fine. There's 3 exams, if you go to reviews and study you'll get an A+ every time. You do need the book. I highly recommend Janowsky, she's one of the best professors at UCF.

Impossible test. Does not go over information the way is showed in the exam. Too hard she's cool nice and funny but teat are miserable spent 12 hours reading book and understood 15 out of the 50 questions. Not worth it Shes way too smart

I had her for summer B my first semester at UCF. The lecture comes straight out of the book for the most part. She makes class fun by showing clips from family guy and other shows as examples. She does require you to use a clicker for participation points, but in turn, most clicker questions end up on the test. Fun, Easy class.
Great professor, knows her stuff. Has the showmanship to make learning fun and easy. Loves her some puffins.
Dr. J is great, take this class if you can!

This class is hard, so be prepared to work for a good grade. AJ is soooo helpful though, she wants every single one of her students to get a good grade. She goes over everything with detail and makes sure you understand before she goes to the next lesson. And she's FUNNY.. she  makes a boring subject seem interesting.

If you want to learn, take this professor but if you intend on slacking off, this class is not for you. I had a wonderful experience, all due to her helpfulness and amusing anecdotes (they really help you learn!). She really is a nice woman, very intelligent, and hilarious!
Hilarious!!

Assignments were very clear on what you needed to do. The R software is hard to use in general, so the confusion on that is not necessarily her fault. Assignments open on Tuesdays so you don't have the whole week. Zoom lectures were long and hard to get through. This class is hard no matter what but I think she was a good professor to have for this
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Literally the best and easiest class. Everything comes straight from the textbook and while idk my grade I'm confident it is an A. Did not take up a lot of my time but I did learn a lot. Highly recommend taking this class!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: this class was so good i want to gatekeep it, the chapters were so long but you can get away with skimming it. few assignments, super chill and up to 10 extra credit points
Very interesting course. Outlines provided by the professor were helpful. Definitely a lot of reading though

Dont worry about this professor, this class is extremely manageable and easy to keep up with. There are quasi-weekly assignments, and all of the intensive homework is near the beginning of the class. Once the semester picks up, you find yourself doing -less- work. Final Paper is create-your-topic and therefore fun only if you dont hate Europe lol

This is my second class with Dr. Kinsey and I already registered for the next one. I will never get tired of her teaching style. She is a kind and wonderful person and an extremely well-prepared Professor. I owe her my capacity to see the social problems with a different perspective. The day I graduate I hope to see her to give her big hug.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class probably prepared me well for grad work. There was not one textbook, but many classical readings (you'll buy six or seven books but easy to find open source or used.) Great way to get a basis of theory; her modules and outlines encouraged drawing correlation between the multiple readings. Encourages active thought, not easy but valuable.

Professor Kinsey is great!  This class gave me a good insight about the immense effects that income inequality has on our global economy. She selected various authors so you can compare and come up with your own conclusions . This class requires reading, discussions, quizzes, essays and a 3000 words research paper. Viable A if you do your work.

Professor Kinsey is amazing!  This class gave me a good insight about the immense effects that income inequality has on our global economy. She selected various authors so you can compare and come up with your own conclusions . This class requires reading, discussions, quizzes, essays and a 3000 words research paper. Viable A if you do your work.
Don't take this class if you don't have extra amount of time to read.....Hard but clear instruction...
Participate in class, or it will seem to drag on forever.  If you're wrong, Dr. Kinsey will explain things until you get it.  She's incredibly helpful, so don't hesitate to ask questions.

Boring class, good professor. It is basically applied statistics for political science and anyone could teach it and it would be boring. Dr. Kinsey makes sure you understand everything while she is teaching and will not make you feel stupid for asking a question. Open book/handout exams and homework are your grade. Definitely take her!
She helps one understand the fine points of sometimes difficult but always deep reading. Her passion for the material and willingness to guide her students creates a good atmosphere for discussion.

Dr. Kinsey is a good teacher.  Be prepared for Statistics!  She is willing to help out her students for whatever the reason.  She is from Greece and has an accent, but understandable. SPS CD and workbook are used a lot.  Its a breeze if you have taken a stats course, this class can be intense over summer without it. Open book/handouts/formula exams

Dr. Kinsey is a great Professor. Although she is Greek and her english is good, but not excellent, she still manages to be great. Her lectures can be a bit boring and her organization may not be the best; however, she is always available to help and will bend over backwards to make sure you pass.
There are four exams that are just essays. If you want to learn, you have to pay attention in class. The professor is really nice, and there's nothing different from the syllabus.

This class was easy but super boring and he didn't even have any notes on canvas. The only assignments we ever had were a syllabus quiz and 4 exam papers that were all the same; write two essays in the span of 1 week. Honestly, as long as you have google, you don't even have to go to class most days.

Class consisted of three take home tests (2 five hundred word prompts) and an eight page paper that he gives you all semester to work on. Attendance is not mandatory and you can still make an A without going. He is a very caring guy, and wants to help make the material interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: engaging lectures and makes the material interesting

Professor Farcau is an extremely funny guy, and makes lectures enjoyable by cracking jokes throughout teaching. The grade is based on three mini-papers and one term paper, and as long as you attend class and pay attention to lectures and how he likes to grade, you'll do fine. The class is lecture-based, and he teaches only by talking, no slideshow.

The class wasn't bad - as long as you put effort into the four papers you'll get an A - but I wasn't a fan of Farcau. It was a 'professor lectures and you discuss,' which I'm normally cool with, but I didn't like how he went on long tangents about his former jobs/experience with the government and irrelevant things to the content we were learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best prof ever !!! Prof Farcau is so funny and has the best lectures, he really gets you intrigued in the material. There are only 4 grades for the semester with 3 being essay exams and one being a term paper. Overall a great course to take!! Highly recommend.

Honestly loved this class, the lectures were interesting and you were graded off three take home essay tests and one eight page paper due at the end of the semester. I liked the little amount of assignments so this class was super easy, just make sure to avoid any bias in your papers.

Good Professor. His lectures are very informative but he is more on the republican/conservative and shows it from things he says sometimes so don't take this prof if this bothers you. The tests are 2 essay questions, 500 words min each, but write a minimum of 700 per question if you want to get 90+ on them.
Professor Farcau is so amazing! Hes laidback and very accessible. Read the book and youll pass. Honestly one of the best professors Ive ever had at UCF will definitely take him again!

Consists of 4 grades, tests 1, 2, & 3, and a term paper.  There are in-class tests that are multiple-choice and full-page essay. Then there are take-home tests where you need to write 2 (given 3 options)  essays at a length of preferably 700 minimum words. He asks for 400 usually but he grades by content and length. Easy A if you're on top of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Farcau is amazing! I loved his teaching style as it was simple and clear cut. Don't really have to show up for lectures, but its good to go if you want to build a relationship with him or want him to know you personally. Didn't use the textbook. Just took notes in class and always did the take home test option. Easy A.

The most amazing Professor at UCF! I've take 4 classes with him so far and have made all A's. His tests are easy and composed of essays and you have the choice of doing an in class or take home test. This man is brilliant and his sense of humor is one of a kind. Hands down the best teacher I've ever had.

Prof Farcau makes poli sci classes at 8AM worth getting up for, his lectures are awesome. His tests are essays and short response, but you should know that when he says 'short response' he means a paragraph and when he says 'at least 500 words' he means at least 750; more is better. Hard to get an A, but not impossible. Skip buying the books.

His version of history is hilarious and the only thing that makes it better is his insistence that historians are "revisionists." Class is like "listen to the crazy man talk and then laugh at him" time and exams are "regurgitate what the crazy man said and get an A." He insists that the domino theory is true..even tho Saigon fell and that's it LOL

Prof Farcau is a rabid right winger. I literally wouldn't be surprised if he was a card holding John Birch Society member. It's not just his opinions, but the version of history that he teaches is very very conservative. For example, apparently, McCarthy and friends were the real victims of a vast liberal/communist conspiracy. No joke.

I would have to agree with the last for comments; he is fairly clear most of the time, he can be kind of opinionated, and he definitely knows what he's talking about. He sometimes adds sarcasm or something funny to get the class' attention and understands if a student needs to leave class early. He did review for the first test, which is in 2 days.

AMAZING professor! Farcau is extremely intelligent and experienced in his field of politics - he will consistently bring up personal stories of working for US govmt during lecture. He is very saracastic and funny as well. Farcau does a wonderful job of communicating the material. In Diplomacy he always offers takehome or inclass tests which is nice
I had him for Strat. Weapons and Arms Control. He can be subtly opinionated and a bit repetitive but he knows what he's talking about. He is pretty clear with notes and his reviews work very well.
His classes are always fun and interesting; he may not care if you go to class but if you go you will learn.

Took him for Diplomacy as well as Strategic Weapons and Arms Control.  Just go to class, write down what he says...he tells you everything you need for the essays then.  Book helps too.  Gives extra credit opportunities, however, you can also chose to just not go to the in class exams and do a take home make up which is way easier.

DONT TAKE HIS CLASS. I just finished my final test and for the past 2 tests we've had, he's done reviews and NOTHING from the review is on the test. His class consists of him asking about the recent issues in the news and talking about that for about 20 minutes and then finally starts talking about something that seems to be relevant but with all t

Her tests are difficult in both essentials and adult 1, but an important tip is to listen to her narrated PowerPoints in the modules. Those contain the most important topics for the test. She makes her tests similar to the NCLEX, so learning how to study for her tests will help in the long run. Breaking each condition down into categories helps

Very nice person but not very effective in teaching material. Book is too much information and powerpoints are too little. You really must read the chapters. Tested on topics barely covered in class as she usually runs out of time to finish topics, so get ready to teach yourself. Rarely gives breaks during class. Excellent in clinical setting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Get the textbook and read it. She loves charts, tables and the objectives at the beginning of her powerpoints (so know the answers to those). The material seems very easy but I promise you need to read most of the chapters, at least once. Adaptive quizzing isn't very helpful. Watch the videos and do the short quizzes at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Really difficult tests. Every answer is the right answer, but choose the one that is the most right. You better know every little detail. She reads directly from her PowerPoints for lecture.

Dissapointed that the class was really easy. The goal of upper level classes are to broaden intellectual horizons, but I just ended up relying on common sense. If you just need to take an elective and want an easy "A", take this class. If you want to develop intellectually, take a different class. 3 tests released early. Never touched the book.

Instructor was knowledgable and always willing to help. Projects utilized MS Excel and were explained in detail more than once along with tutorials to show how to do them. You were allowed to use your notes for all tests.  Good insight on how to use statistical tools and interpreting the results.

He did a great job at teaching this course.  This class is very detailed oriented and you need to be there to get it all.  If you get behind it is NOT easy to catch up. ASK Questions.  He will do his best to make sure you understand.
Took for Quant II. Was easy, however, time consuming. I did not do as well as I could b/c of the time I had to spend on Cornerstone.

Class is a little boring, but he is a great guy and is always willing to help.  If you follow the homework and write down the definitions on the cheat sheet he allows, you will have no problems on the test. The project is a little confusing but he is always willing to help out.

Great Professor, knows his stuff! Explains better than book, so I didn’t read it. I would recommend him to anyone. Go to every class and write down everything. Do some of the homework and you will do fine. You are allowed 1 page cheat sheet that helps a lot.

Had for Quant I & II, great guy and brilliant, but confusing when teaches, quizes can be taken until 100, help sheets can be used for tests.  Easy A if you use his practice exams as help sheets, just shrink down to 1 page front/back. Go to reviews and tests, don't need to go other times.
His class is easy if you don't want to truly learn the course, just make a grade. Quizes are redoable until 100% right, lets you have notes for all exams!
I have him for Quant. Business Tools 1.  He is very nice, but soooo boring.  He beats every problem to death and leaves you totally confused. Lots of homework and weekly quizzes.

Ever seen "Ferris Bueller's Day Off?" Then whenever you are sitting in his class, listening to him drone on, you will hear the phrase "Anyone? Anyone?" Nice guy, but dry. Expect to spend 4-5 hours a week on homework and studying for biweekly quizzes.

She has long ass videos where she speaks slow as hell, even though I put the speed at the maximum that allows me (1.25x), you need a 94% to get an A which is devious and many of her questions on the test when I went to the office where not even in the videos, she was always saying you should read the text book as well which is insanely long.

Super easy class, there are 5 exams but as long as you go through her lecture videos and the textbook study tool you are fine, her lectures for the most part are short and useful. She provides extra credit work about three times. You can really tell she loves her job and Marketing. I would definitely take her again.

The class is not hard, but it will take a bit of your time & that is largely attributed to the fact the course has 5 exams. Important to read the textbook to do well on the HW & to watch her vids for a better understanding. Simulations are easy but you will have to work as a group to get sims turned in & for the final simulation. Below a 92 is a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor takes too long to speak in her videos, is very rude in her emails, and the grading scale is very misleading. I'm also pretty sure that she's writing her own good reviews in here as well.

So many assignments. Need 940/1000 points to get an A. Most of the points are easy to get though. Exams require a little more studying, but she provides great outlines of where to focus. Can be an easy A if you don't slack. There were two extra credit labs worth 20 points total. No actual work, just participate in surveys.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Good professor who clearly loves what she does! The course is really interesting and has a lot of content. Taking this for summer but dislike that she crammed 16 weeks of work in 6. The amount of busy work makes learning from the textbook unenjoyable. Would love this course more if she focused whats on the textbook and not random assignments.

She teaches students to deeply understand the knowledge and apply it to real life. It is disappointing to see so many students cheating the system and skipping such things to actually learn. You can cheat your way through but you pay good money for a reason. Finally the textbooks are expensive but ultimately are used and effective.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: She is the best! Easy A! Watch her lectures, so you know the specific questions on the exam and how to do the simulations. She is so funny and shares life messages. The grading scale is a little messed up because you have to have a 94 or higher to have an A, but its not hard to obtain. I ended with a 99%.

Let me say this plain and simple: She can be iffy at times. The exams can be challenging and it all depends on which exam you are given as it is based on a test bank. However, this professor really does care. She loves teaching and her office is always open. The energy and dedication she has makes this class enjoyable. She doesn't view you as less.

Dr. Massiah is the best professor at UCF! Her lectures are entertaining, her exams reflect her study guides perfectly, she cares a lot about her students, and gives lots of extra credit. She even took the time to write a personal email to me congratulating me on a good exam score. In a class of 1400, that communication is awesome. Take her class!!!

I took this class as a mini-mester summer class (which I would recommend) but it is a fast paced class. Dr. Massiah was clear and concise about her requirements and rules.  Follow them and you will be fine.  I really enjoyed the class.

Powerpoints slides, Biz Sim Presentation, Interview paper.  Go to class, or work, interact with him, you will be fine.  I think he is a good teacher.  I have him for cornerstone this semester too and signed up for capstone in the fall with him.  I recommend him =]

Unprepared, disorganized, forgetful, etc.  What more can be said.  He forgets what he tells the class and doesn't grade according to the guidelines set.  He shouldn't be teaching college level classes.

Informative yes.  Unfair at times yes.  He does care about the class and his students.  Alot of the problems with this class are out of his control.  To the people who have not taken this class yet, you are luck the format is changing.  In my opinion, they should drop the lecture part and keep the project part.  That was alot of work but helpful.
SUCKS! Avoid. Seems nice but unfair. I would never trust him with my grade ever again. My 3 year old could have done a better job!
Very vague and lazy.  Forgets to provide complete directions, always finds ways to lower grade.  unfriendly and shows favoritism

if You really wana do well you will.  I worked hard and got what i needed.  He was more than fair with everyone in my class.  Callerman is the problem

Charles is an awesome teacher! The content for this course is difficult and the course requires a lot of work but he's a great professor and makes the class enjoyable
charlie is the man! great teacher, straight forward and to the point. helpful if you need assistance. respect him and he will respect you.

Awesome Professor! He has to be one of the most straight forward professors at UCF. He does not try to trick you on Exams and fair on grading papers. Charles is Awesome! Hands down the best SBU mgr! He's fair, funny, knowledgeable, and very helpful. This class is not difficult and the tests are far from hard but there is SO MUCH material to cover in a short amount of time. I would not recommend taking this class over the summer. One pro is no textbook though!

Took the class online in 6wk because I thought it would be fun class- big mistake. My 4.0 was ruined in my last semester. The class wasn't hard, but the amount of material covered is insane and it is nearly impossible to finish the quizzes on time. He might be better in lecture but I would not take him again.

By far the most organized professor. I took him for Social Psychology. Very helpful and will always be thorough in answering any question. You must read the book and the articles and especially go to class. There are lots of questions from all three on the tests.
I'm still waiting for the grades to come out, I'm worried because my lab TA's an idiot...hope I pass.

I was scared going into this class but its not bad. The course is so organized and Dr. Chin will always answer your questions. Go to the reviews, pay attention to the lectures, read the articles, turn in rough drafts for the lab. Its a 5 credit class so yes you will have to try. But its not that bad! Useful information
reads from powerpoints that are posted on the internet. This was a very fun class "psychology of human and animal interaction" . Must read the text but most of it is pretty interesting

His lectures are clear, and he makes the information easy and entertaining.  Pay attention in class and read about the experiments. Take him if you get the chance.
Don't remember course number. This was a special topic class: Human-Animal Interaction. Well done, organized, and fun!

he was easy to understand during class...but his tests were very unclear. he gets a a little defensive when you ask him a question and tends to contradict himself when that happens. fun projects though
Dr. Chin has a difficult testing style but you totally gives you all the material that will be on the exam. I learned a lot!

Honestly I thought the guy was great.  I've talked to others who failed this same course.  Dr. Craanen really cut out a lot of unnecessary work for us but as you can tell from the reviews, some people are never happy.  We had a lot of lazy people in the class and way too many non-education majors.

I don't know why people are upset, the professor was really nice, understanding, helpful, and gave feedback. He gave multiple chances for students to meet deadlines. Be nice and he'll do the same.

He was not prepared to teach this class. Every week expectations will be different. He expects more out of you than he will give in return. Great class.  Great professor.  Entertaining and informative.  Learned a great deal.  Dr. Covelli is great.

His presentations he was very funny in a high energy way, and used thumbs up memes as feedback for quizzes. You can see everything ahead of time so you can work at your own pace which I really appreciate.

LOVE this professor, haven't even finished the class but I needed to tell someone how much i love this class. Great professor. People still show up to class by the end of the semester. You actually learn in his lectures. His tests are similar to homework and in class problems. And he gives 11 points of extra credit at the end

Dr. Deng is incredible. knowledgeable professor and reachable outside of class AND grades are posted the same day. Posts all of his lecture notes and office hours are very helpful. People go to class even if its not mandatory from so inspirational that it is.

Angel fallen from the sky.

reviews.comment: Based on the first section of the course, extremely reasonable HW, extremely reasonable quizzes, and extremely reasonable exams. If you prepare the way he encourages you to, you will do fine in this class.
I love Zhipeng Deng because he is the bestest professor ever
The goat, tests you fairly

Best class I've taken in college. Dusseau is the best professor I've had as well. extremely personable and cares about her students. Huge lit review paper at the end of the semester but she's super helpful with it.

Great professor! Great teacher, very funny and entertaining.  Subject was interesting and easy to understand.

This man is by far the worst organic chemistry professor in the history of all chemistry professors in general. Is perfectly okay with his class having an overall average of a D and an F on exams. No type of curve given in an online class. Not teaching a lecture for students to properly understand. Does not care for his students! Absolutely sucks!

You will learn a lot with him. He seems to be very A.D.D. and talks fast. Yes, he is a little arrogant and can make you feel "little" one on one, but honestly he is overall an AMAZING teacher. I hate organic and got an A on almost all his test. He prepares you very well for his tests. Just know everything on his chapter review lists and study!!

Dr. E is a very picky, intense prof. He will FLY over the topic, but he is very funny in his lecutres. Trust me: GO TO HIS OFFICE and put aside his "Ego" and just let him teach you b/c he will break things down for you in his office. I studied about 25hrs/week. Still got a B.
Terrible professor.  Unhelpful, rude, and grades unfairly.  I am saying this and I recieved a B in his class.  He has favorites and grades accordingly.

One of the best criminal justice professors.  Class was not difficult but you do have to pay attention and take notes.  4 tests and final is cumulative.  Only a few homework assignments but not difficult at all.
Great teacher. Make sure to write everything down that he writes on the board because that is where the test comes from.  Overall great teacher.
Mr. Eastep is a great teacher. Knows a lot of good information and is very easy to talk to if you have any issues. Take class notes and take part in class discussions.
Mr. Eastep is wonderful! Closed book tests with lots of material so study hard for them.  He is always willing to help his students and provides a friendly learning atmosphere.

I wouldn't take her class again, she kept moving classes to online the day of, it was supposed to be a mixed mode class but we barely had any classes in person so good luck if you actually want to understand the material. She seems nice but the only 3 lectures we did have in person were kinda boring.Self-studying and hard exams but doable

She's nice, but I was honestly confused for most of the semester. The lab/in-person lecture days were switched to online I don't know how many times, which I don't mind, but she would make an announcement basically the day before or the day of and materials took a while to be posted so you can't work ahead.

Honestly a pretty forgettable and uninspiring professor. Lectures optional, labs were mandatory, exams online. She seems really sweet, but her lectures felt like forever. Three labs, pretty simple. 2 exams that aren't the easiest, but if you study, you will be ok. Just do your HW and go to labs, and your grade will be just fine. Didn't LOVE her, but I'd take her again.
He's been very supportive throughout the semester if you need a help just go ask.  Very knowledgeable in his area. I'd recommend him. I give 4/5 just because he changes his syllabus often.

Make sure you attend his classes although participation is not mandatory. I pretty much enjoyed his classes. He has been very supportive throughout the semester. This is engineering economics class but he is very knowledgeable in his field and research. I'll take any courses in the structures field from him in the future.

He does not know how to teach the material effectively and correctly. He often had pauses in the lecture because he did not know how to answer the practice problem he put up. He was okay. He doesn't follow his own syllabus and when asked to explain a topic because of confusion, not explained very well. I was able to teach myself the material with the help of YouTube and mentors but not him.

He is a nice person and has a good heart. His passion about the subject he teaches is evident for sure. However, the workload is absolutely preposterous, redundant and unnecessary. I would not reccomend this class to anyone, especially alongside internship 1. You will feel like youre drowning.

Dr. Dan is amazing, yes his class has some work each week, and a teachers in action project but it was all relevant. He is a kind and wonderful human being who cares about each and every one of his students and their success. He has been my sounding board all semester and I am so grateful to know and have known him. Simply wonderful!

Dr. Dan is easily one of the best professors in the education field. I enjoyed his class so much and the work was manageable. The class consists of discussions, presentations, reflections, and workshops.
Please take his class !! He is also a magician so look forward to cute and fun magic tricks!

I hate to give Dr. Dan such a low rating as he is a very nice professor but I have never been so stressed in any other semester. The amount of assignments a week made me dread every single Tuesday. Dr. Dan is a great professor, he just assigns way too much work. I had 4 other classes along with his and I felt like I was taking 7. His lectures are great, but be prepared for LOTS of projects and papers.

reviews.comment: The workload for this course is quite a lot and most of it felt like busy work. On top of full-time school, work and homelife I found this class to be the most stressful one I've taken yet.

Get ready for SO MUCH HOMEWORK! There are over 70+ assignments with around 6-8 being due each week with one being a project worth 100 points. All the assignments are redundant and boring. You also have a group service learning project where you need to do 15 hours while being in internship. My advice is to take the other professor!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He's kind, but he gives an unnecessary amount of weekly work. It's simple but tedious & very redundant. It's usually at least 5 different things that are all due on Sunday. This class is taken w/ an internship, so the excessive homework gets old. Only take him if you're okay with lots of tedious homework that feels like the same thing every week.

This is my second class with Dr. Dan the Magic Man. I liked him so much in the first one that I made sure to choose him for this class as well.  He has a big heart for what he does as you can see in his videos.  There are weekly assignments and videos to keep you engaged and while it may be work it is easy interesting entertaining and beneficial!

I am shocked to see so many negative reviews.  Dr. Dan cares so much about his students and making them great future teachers.  His videos are strange but are meant to keep you engaged.  TONS of assignments - discussion posts, small projects (one requires 15 hours of volunteering), reflections.  If you do the assignments, you'll get an A.

This professor is the worst education professor I've ever had. First, I've found it hard to reach him despite this being an online class. I warn you do not take his class choose a different professor! He does not grade off of a rubric for assignment it will be just a paragraph of what you will do. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class is super easy if you do all the work. There are a lot of discussion posts, however you don't really need to read the whole chapter to complete them. His quizzes are unlimited times, so impossible to fail them. And only one final project that he gives the whole semester to work on. Not a tough grader either, an interesting class.

Dr. Dan is so sweet! Every week we have three discussion posts but they're super easy and you really don't need to read for them. Then you have two assignments, but again easy stuff, and lastly a quiz you can take as many times as you want. I'm a C's earn degrees type and the class is just fine.

Dr. Ezell was a very caring professor. I could tell he had a passion for education and was willing to help if needed. His class was concise. Two main projects and rests was discussions. Had him online, he is a great professor and he's really funny and caring. Assignments are due every Sunday, the work looks like a lot but it's not. Everything you learn is very informational and with help you in the future! Highly recommend taking his class.

This prof clearly cares a lot about this course. However, there is a lot of busy work and he is a tough grader at times. He's one of my favorite professors. He's such a funny guy and makes sure you understand the content. If you ever have the chance, take his class. You'll be happy that you did!

Way too much busy work! It is not difficult work but it is so much! I had anywhere from ten to thirteen assignments a week.

This class could be a little more interesting, it feels more like busy work since the content is just consistently the same thing over and over. It is easy though, don't get me wrong. His amount of work looks scary, but it is not that bad, you just it one week at a time. I enjoyed his class and learned a lot. I took class online replied to e-mails within 24 hours.  Great class you will learn a lot!

Dr. Dan the magic man is an incredible person.  When I first met him I utterly refused to take his course. Dr. Ezell does a great job about making this class fun, this does include magic tricks! He is very passionate about what he is teaching. Don't let the long list of assignments intimidate you, there not that hard and I actually enjoyed doing most of them. He grades pretty fair and quickly as well! Take him, you'll learn a ot about an important topic

Dr. Dan is a fabulous teacher. He does give ALOT of assignments/projects but this is college, its not supposed to be a cake walk. Hes a fair grader as well. Complete your work on time and no problem recieving an A. Good teacher!
Great Teacher, Have taken many of his classes and got all A's! He gives you a lot of work but it is easy, as long as you stay up with the work load. Which isn't too hard!
enormous amount of assignments.  but pretty fair grader.

Excellent Professor... learned so much!
AWESOME!!!!! Nothing bad to say!!

Great loving teacher.  You can tell that this is his true passion.  man is hard to read sometimes but will work with you till you understand.  Dresses nice and very nice to look at.  take him if you can becuae you will learn more than you ever thought possible!!!  Go Elem ed
Was awesome, helpful and I would strongly recommend taking classes with him.

She went above and beyond to be there for her students. She is an inspirational teacher who cares about her students and their success as reading teachers. PHENOMENAL

If she feels like you are a lazy student, even if you really are not she treats you differently than the other students. She grades your assignments more harshly, give you an attitude, and I just did not feel comfortable after she started looking at me that way towards the end of the semester and yet I was not a lazy student. I completed everything

I'm not saying it cannot be done, but you have to put in work

I think I managed to get the A through sheer insistance, i consumed every bit of content she put online and you really have to pay attention to lectures, also go to test review office hours, thats the only way to improve for the final.
